quest.title: Disputes Without Honor and Humanity
quest.description: The Izmaylovs are indeed trying to find a way to open the Shadow Realm under the leadership of its boss, the Little Sire. To gather more information, we must rescue Gureva from their base, an undercover operative who has lost contact...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After returning to the Luchkin stronghold...\nYou hand the cargo sample you recovered to Zmei...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are things alright...?

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: So, is it really...?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Normally, I'd say I've got good news and bad news. But things are worse than we expected. There's only bad news, and worse news...

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Then the Young Sire really is...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Trying to open the Shadow Realm. Yes. That's the bad news.

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: What's the worse news?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: He's nearly there. Maybe not all the way yet, but close...

choices.text: You can tell that much from it?

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: When I was a child, I even... entered the Shadow Realm once. Only, it wasn't exactly a pleasant memory for me.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: After that, I never wanted anything to do with the Shadow Realm again.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: ...He's refining Kresnik Kristall. Once it's pure enough, it can act as the "key" — the energy source needed to start the mechanism that opens the Shadow Realm.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Oh, that's not good. That means the mechanism is already built, at least...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Seems that way...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hold on a second! How do you gang members know all this Shadow Realm stuff...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Gangs really can get their hands on anything, huh?

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Don't give us too much credit. The Old Sire just happens to have... a few strings he can pull at the Energy Commission.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Some of our people have done odd jobs for the Commission's higher-ups before. Once someone sets their mind to finding it... especially someone with an agenda, information like that isn't hard to get.

response.speaker: Iryna
response.text: What's he after?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... Why would he want to open the Shadow Realm in the first place?

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: ...Maybe for the ruins drifting through it? Maybe to open it right in front of the Zapolyarny Palace and turn it into some kind of man-made disaster? No one knows.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: The Shadow Realm is dangerous. Whatever he's planning, I'm sure it's nothing good... But his motive isn't what matters most right now. The real issue is—

response.speaker: Iryna
response.text: Where the mechanism that opens the Shadow Realm is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon gets it! If we break down that mechanism first, then whatever scheme he's cooking up goes nowhere.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Precisely. And as luck would have it, before we sent you after the samples, one of ours had already slipped inside one of Izmaylov's major strongholds. She might know something.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Right — Gureva. She's... she's amazing. She found a way to warn us about Izmaylov using the trains to move supplies, and even about Lorie's cargo run.

response.speaker: Iryna
response.text: In other words, much more reliable than a certain rabbit.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: ...H-Hey. I just... act before I think sometimes.

response.speaker: Iryna
response.text: Still, as for Gureva...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Oh, oh, for sure

response.speaker: Iryna
response.text: Her mission window has already passed, but she never checked back in.

response.speaker: Iryna
response.text: We sent people to look for her, but so far, no one's found a trace.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: What!? Gureva? No... that can't be right!

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Exactly. Gureva is never late, and she never leaves people waiting...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Then she must be in trouble?

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: I'm afraid so. And that makes this much worse. She slipped into a stronghold run by the Young Sire's second-in-command...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: If they found her out, the man they call "the Butcher" won't let her off easy.

response.speaker: Iryna
response.text: Could they have seen through her disguise?

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: No. Gureva has always kept to the shadows... She's not like us. Izmaylov's people wouldn't know her face.

response.speaker: Iryna
response.text: Then... could she have already...?

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: No, no, she can't be. H-How could she be...? Gureva...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: I don't believe the Butcher would do something like that right away. From what we know about him, he'd try to get more information out of Miss Gureva first.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: If I were him, I'd do the same...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: I-Is that... how it works?

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: I know Miss Gureva won't tell them anything. But that means we have to help her right away... before the Butcher completely runs out of patience with her.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: But...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: There's no time to argue. I'm going to save Gureva!

response.speaker: Iryna
response.text: And get yourself killed?

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: *sob* ...Maybe, but doing nothing would feel even worse.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: That sort of impulse can put you in danger faster than you realize. *sigh*

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, I know this is a lot to ask... but will you help us rescue Gureva?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm... Sounds like Gureva's in real danger, {NICKNAME}...

choices.text: Hmm... A slightly bigger reward might help make up our minds.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Of course! If you save Gureva, I'll give you the fur right off my back. I won't even argue!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, that really won't be necessary! Snezhnaya's cold enough already. Keep your fur, Sofya.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, where exactly is the stronghold Gureva snuck into?

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Northwest of Snezhnograd. It used to be a Fatui military base, but it was abandoned some time ago...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: From there, it changed hands a few times before eventually ending up with Izmaylov.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Gangs really can get their hands on anything, huh?

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Mora can get you just about anything. With enough of it changing hands, even the ley lines might start moving a little faster. So, getting hold of one small abandoned base wouldn't be much of a challenge.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: And among all the gangs, Izmaylov has always been the richest.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: From what we've heard, the place is heavily guarded. A frontal assault won't be easy, so whatever you do... please be careful. We want Gureva back alive, but your safety matters to us too.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: If rescuing her turns out to be impossible, retreat immediately.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Got it! We're on the case!

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: U-Um, Zmei... I know you don't really like sending me out on missions, but... this is Gureva...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Can I... Can I go with them? I'm really worried about her...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Hmm... All right. Just don't slow anyone down. Go get everything you'll need for the mission...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: O-Okay... I'll get ready right away... Gureva, please be okay...

choices.text: Well, we didn't say we wouldn't help.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: R—Really?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll help, of course. But this is extra work, so don't forget to add a little something to the reward, okay?

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Naturally. Luchkin would never let friends who came to our aid leave disappointed.

choices.text: You know the Shadow Realm that well?

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: This place used to be a Fatui base. The layout inside is confusing, so keep your guard up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, we haven't even reached the entrance, and there are already a ton of guards! How are we getting in?

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Gureva said the main gate would be closely guarded. But there's a hole above it where part of the structure collapsed...

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: We might be able to get through from there.

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: ...If we move any farther, they'll notice us.

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Right... We'd be noticed right away...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Gotcha! Since we're new faces here, they won't recognize us. Leave the rest to Paimon and {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Then we're counting on you to rescue Gureva!

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Iryna and I will wait outside and back you up, just like we did last time — when you went in to steal the sample!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then don't forget to have the sled ready again, Sofya!

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: ...Haha, don't worry, I won't. Whatever you need, I'll have it ready for you!

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: #Just come back safe, okay? {NICKNAME}, Paimon.

talks.objective: Go to the cave entrance above the gate
Observe the situation inside the base

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ring ring~ RING~

dialogues.speaker: Muscular Guard
dialogues.text: What’s that noise? Why is it so loud? Kubiyev, go check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Confused Guard
dialogues.text: It's a matryoshka. Strange... Is something inside the doll making that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Confused Guard
dialogues.text: Huh. Open one up, and there's another one inside... Who put this thing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that guy's attention is caught by that weird doll. This is our chance to sneak past!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Zmei! We're here! Huh? Wait, where are Iryna, Sofya, and Gureva?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: There's still much to be done regarding Izmaylov, so they have all been busy attending to that.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Oh, right. Aside from the reward we promised you before, we all agreed you should have these two as gifts, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: This is... made from refined Kresnik Kristall...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A "key" to the Shadow Realm?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: More precisely, it was the key used to activate the device that opened the Shadow Realm. But now that the device has been destroyed, it no longer has much use...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: At this point, it is little more than a block of energy. It would be rather difficult for us to keep, but perhaps you will find some use for it.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Let us say we are passing along a troublesome little package — one that seems far less troublesome in your hands than in ours.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Troublesome little packages are only good when they come with snacks inside. Anyway, what's the second one?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: And the second gift... is this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is it? A map...? Looks like something's marked on it.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Do you remember the box Gureva took from the Butcher's desk? We had it opened, and found this map inside.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: This actually goes back to an old rumor... They say there was once a group of thieves who made a living robbing other gangs. After hitting one gang after another, they hid all the loot away somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: We always assumed it was just a story, but now it seems that so-called "legendary thief's treasure" may have been real after all.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: The Butcher probably found a lead and got hold of the treasure map. Izmaylov was short on money at the time, after all. He just never managed to get the box open.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... But if this really is the "legendary thief's treasure," shouldn't you keep it for yourselves?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Luchkin still seems like it could really...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Haha... How should I put this? Sofya may have said something before about "justice earning no Mora"?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: But to me, that is exactly what keeps justice clean. It is not about money, and it is not about what we stand to gain.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Besides, it is only a map. Actually finding the treasure would still take time, effort, and plenty of people... Still, I have to admit, it does feel like a shame to hand it over.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Quick, take them before I start having second thoughts!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—You're not really having second thoughts, are you, Zmei?

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Well, no promises...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: That should be everything, then. I will not keep you two from your journey any longer. If you ever have time to spare, please come and visit. The others would be happy to see you.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: You two will always have a place in Luchkin, our remarkable travelers from afar.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Mmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Zmei! We're here! Huh? Wait, where are Iryna, Sofya, and Gureva?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: There's still much to be done regarding Izmaylov, so they have all been busy attending to that.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei

dialogues.speaker: Zmei

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Troublesome little packages are only good when they come with snacks inside.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #And come to think of it, {NICKNAME}, didn't Alyosha say he was looking for something like this? Maybe this is exactly what he meant?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then let's show it to him later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good idea. Now, where were we... Zmei, you said you had two things for us, right? One of them is this weird core, so what's the other?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: The second gift... is this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is it? A map...? Looks like something's marked on it.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei

response.speaker: Zmei

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Hm.

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: Hm? You're not the Butcher... Wait, you're not an Izmaylov either.

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: So, who are you? Did Zmei or Iryna send you here? Oh my, I thought they would be coming by in person.

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: Haha, is that so? Funny. I don't recall Izmaylov having any humans in its ranks. Especially not one with footsteps as light as yours.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, you got us. Zmei did ask us to come. Sofya too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're Gureva, right?

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: Yes... But listen, friends. This place is dangerous, so don't worry about getting me out. Just help me pass on a message. Listen carefully...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Once we get you out of here, you can tell them yourself!

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: ...Well, aren't you two wonderful. Bright and steady, like a little sun and a little star. Looks like Zmei finally picked the right people for once. How nice... I like you two already!

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: Now then, little sun, come help me get this door open!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Open the door...)

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: Thank you. The last few days have been exhausting. When I get back, I'm definitely asking Zmei for a raise.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, we've gotta go before anyone notices!

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: ...Now, now, no need to rush. What's this cute little white star's name?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean Paimon? Paimon's name is Paimon!

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: And this little golden sun here?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #{NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hold on! We don't have time to stand around introducing ourselves!

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: It‘s all right. The only person who comes here is the Butcher, and he isn’t due back for a good while yet.

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: After three days locked in this place, a few more minutes won't hurt. And besides, well...

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: Let's just say I don't take things lying down. If someone insults me, I give it right back. If someone hits me, I hit back. So I'm not about to run off with my tail between my legs...

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: Not before we leave our dear friend the Butcher a proper little parting gift.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then we'll wait nearby, and the moment the Butcher walks in, we'll jump him!

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: Haha, no need for our sweet new friends to get involved. Just hide behind those crates outside for a little while...

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: I'll be quick. And remember, not a sound, okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Sure!

choices.text: I'm not here to play messenger.
I'm a friend of the Luchkin.

response.text: ...Haha. Well, looks like Zmei's finally made some decent friends for once.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep. Zmei sent us here.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You and Paimon have only just hidden behind the crates...\nwhen heavy footsteps begin to echo outside. The door creaks open, and someone steps inside...\nheading straight for Gureva's cell.

dialogues.speaker: The Butcher
dialogues.text: I know you haven't lost your mind. And I'm running out of patience. So tell me what I came here to hear, and maybe I'll make things... a little less painful for you.

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: Oh? How merciful of you, Lord Butcher...

dialogues.speaker: The Butcher
dialogues.text: Justice and mercy are for the weak. Only children who don't know the world still cling to words like that. And you know very well why I've let you live this long.

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: ...You want to know who I'm working for, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: But if you really had faith in the Young Sire, you never would have left me alive. You only did because you were thinking, "Maybe whoever's behind her could give me a way out."

dialogues.speaker: The Butcher
dialogues.text: Silence.

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: We both know the Old Sire's death doesn't add up, right?

dialogues.speaker: The Butcher
dialogues.text: The Old Sire's time was over long ago. If anything, he stuck around too long... Forget it...

dialogues.speaker: The Butcher
dialogues.text: If you're not going to talk, then we'll do this the usual way. Let's get started...

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: Ngh... Ahh...

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: N-No, don't... Please, don't use that... I can't... not again...

dialogues.speaker: The Butcher
dialogues.text: Heh. Thought you'd last longer... Talk, brat. Tell me what I want, and I'll make it stop...

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: Ngh... I'll tell you, I'll tell you... Please, come closer. This isn't for anyone else to hear...

dialogues.speaker: The Butcher
dialogues.text: Heh. See? If you'd just talked sooner, you could've saved yourself a lot of pain...

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: I know... I know I was wrong... Come closer. I'll say it in your ear...

dialogues.speaker: The Butcher
dialogues.text: There. Now, tell me — who are you really... Mmph—

dialogues.speaker: The Butcher
dialogues.text: Um, so... what... what, uh...

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: Shh... Easy now. Relax. Don't tense up... And don't try to call for help. You won't make a sound. Breathe for me. Breathe—

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: Breathe, breathe... Good. That's it. No need to be scared, poor thing. Feeling dizzy is normal...

dialogues.speaker: The Butcher
dialogues.text: Hrk—hah—

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You hear the heavy breathing grow weaker, along with the faint sounds of struggling, until both fade away like ripples on water...\nThen a dull thud breaks the silence — a body hitting the floor, still warm, but lifeless.

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: Let's go. It's over.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A-Are you okay...?

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: I'm fine. In fact, I feel wonderful! Ah, what lovely weather for breaking out of prison!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: R-Right... Good. Then let's get out of here!

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: Come on, we can leave through this passage.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ehh? So the secret passage is right here. Paimon thought we'd have to go back the way we came...

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: Haha, didn't see that coming, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: The Butcher probably never imagined the escape passage was actually right behind his own room. Well... What a shame. I was this close to escaping on my own.

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: And this box. I could always see the Butcher studying it, so there must be something important inside... All right, let's take it with us.

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: It might be some kind of antique. I'll have Zmei take a look at it...

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: After all, as the saying goes, "Steal what the bad guys stole, and the person they stole from will have nowhere to look!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon feels like she's heard something similar from Sofia before. Wait, isn't that way too sad for the person who got robbed!?

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: All right, all right. If we stay any longer, things could get bad. Let's go. It's time for the sun and stars to rise from this gloomy cave.

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: ...Ah, Gureva, Gureva! You came back... *sob*...

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: There, there, little bunny... Don't cry. I came back alive, didn't I? Don't let our friends see you making such a fuss.

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: #*sob*... {NICKNAME}, Paimon... I can't thank you enough...

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: H-How about this? I'm actually pretty proud of my tail. Apart from that one time it got cut by an ice skate blade when I was little, it's never really been hurt...

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: The Old Sire once praised me, "Even among Volkodlak, a fluffy tail like this is quite rare..." Maybe I should cut off my tail and give it to you as thanks...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're not taking someone else's tail!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're happy that we managed to get Gureva out safely.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: *whimper*

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: Little bunny, you can cry if you want, but I'm a injured personal, you know. I can't keep standing here...

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: Besides, I still have things to tell Zmei and Miss Irina. Oof, my lower back hurts, my back hurts all over... I'm telling you, that Butcher...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: All right, all right. I'll take you all back now. This time, I actually rented a proper sleigh... Let's ride back in a bit.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: And that Butcher... I'll beat him up good next time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Paimon, what's wrong?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nothing, nothing. Let's just hurry back!

choices.text: Sorry, but I prefer long tails...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you have a preference in tails... You're not taking someone else's tail!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After returning to the base, Zmei slowly pieced together all the information based on the intel Gureva had gathered.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: #First, I must thank {NICKNAME} and Paimon for rescuing Miss Gureva... She is a very important companion to us...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: I can't thank you enough for this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't mention it!

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: And Miss Gureva... How are you feeling now, Miss Gureva?

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: Not dead yet.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Good enough. Now then, let's talk about this whole incident.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: ...It all began several months ago. One night, we received word that the Old Sire had fallen gravely ill and passed away all of a sudden.

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Yes. The Old Sire was in quite good health, and rumor has it that the last people to see him that night were none other than the Little Sire and the Butcher...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: The old man's death is looking more and more suspicious now...

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: I'm ninety percent sure that this is their doing.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: ...In truth, quite a few people at the High Table suspect the same. After the Old Sire passed away, many of the smaller gangs beneath them fell into chaos.

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: The number of punishments handed down to gang members for violating the "Law" has grown far beyond what it used to be.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Many of those cases were also deeply connected to the Izmaylovs. At the same time, they began spending huge amounts of Mora on some kind of plan, even going so far as to collect debts by force...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's got something to do with the Shadow Realm...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Yes. Either to open the Shadow Realm, or to learn how to open it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But what good would that do?

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: The Little Sire wanted to use such means...

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: ...to prove to the lords above that fae gangs could master technology on par with the Energy Commission. He wanted to use it as a bargaining chip and stake the High Table itself at the roulette table...

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Really? That’s what he wanted?

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: That's what I heard... Unlike us, we furballs are satisfied just rolling around in the furnace ash, but some people have ambitions to plant their backsides in the Snezhnograd Veche.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: He's gone too far down the wrong path. Now, the mechanism for opening the Shadow Realm is already completed...

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: And the "key," that thing made from refined Kresnik Kristall... It's nearly complete as well.

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: All that's left is to insert the key into the mechanism, give it a turn, and then, pop, the Shadow Realm will rise into this world like a fish drawn up to the surface.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so what's that box for? You know, the Butcher's box?

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: It's probably just one of many contingencies, and he never used it in the end. Doesn't seem like anything important.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: It seems more like some strange collectible. Maybe worth looking into... But that's not important now. What matters is...

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: ...We have to stop him, no matter what.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So the question is... where will he try to open the Shadow Realm?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Miss Gureva...

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: At the <color=#00E1FFFF>train boneyard</color>... I also found out the password to get in. It's <color=#00E1FFFF>"Edib"</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: The train boneyard... So that's where it is.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Haha, no, of course not. The train boneyard is just a nickname only the locals know...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Yeah... It's actually a half-excavated tunnel. But after a Shadow Realm disaster caused the tunnel to collapse, the construction work was halted...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: After that, for some reason, it became a dumping ground for abandoned trains.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's why.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: If they open the Shadow Realm there... If things got even slightly out of control, the residents of the surrounding villages and towns would surely be drawn in.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: But to get there, we'd have to pass through the Subzero Zone... Looks like we'll need to prepare a train...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Ugh, but the cost of renting a train...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, we can use our train!

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Huh? Your train? Like a private one?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's... a little hard to explain, but yes, it's our own train.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: That's great... No time to lose. Let's set out right now!

choices.text: Are there train ghosts in the train boneyard?

response.speaker: Gureva
response.text: Hehe, maybe there are ghost trains...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Auh!?

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Don't mind her. Train boneyard is just... just a local nickname...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Welcome aboard our train, everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: #You really... Goodness, {NICKNAME}, you're not some high-ranking Snezhnaya official's illegitimate child, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: The marvelous "outlander traveler" never fails to surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Zmei, Irina, Sofia... Hm? Is Gureva not coming?

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: ...She's injured very badly. It's best to let her get some rest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All right, then let’s set out for the train boneyard.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: The train boneyard... *sigh* Can't believe we're going there...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Something wrong with that place?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: ...Not exactly. It's just that, a long time ago, when we were still children, the Old Sire often took us there to play.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Me, Irina... Vasiliy, who is now called the Little Sire, and... Lyubov, who was sent away to Novokitezhgrad...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Ah, Lyubov is now the head of House Remusov. But his hands aren't exactly clean, and I haven't heard anything about him in a long time...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: In any case, the four of us grew up together. But like branches splitting from the same tree, the farther they grow, the farther apart their tips become.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Everyone has their own path...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Yes, you are right.

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: But crooked branches ought to be pruned.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: No one can define whether another person's path is crooked... We are gangs, after all, herring with one foot in the shadows. What right do we have to define anyone else?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Still, I think what sets us apart from beasts may sometimes be nothing more than a small measure of compassion.

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Compassion?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: It is, in fact, the first line of the Law: Do not commit acts devoid of mercy or justice.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Though whether one acts with mercy and justice ultimately rests with the heart. As I see it, everyone is busy chasing after their own ends, and few truly have the time to look after others.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: But there are always a few moments in life when one faces a choice that can change the course of their path.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: One may choose, "For my own sake, I can hurt anyone else," or think, "Ah, how innocent those who would be hurt are... I simply can't bear it..."

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: That inability to bear it is compassion, and compassion is a humane heart. If you often find yourself unable to bear such things, you may feel that you're still on the right path a person ought to walk.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: But one only needs to choose the former once. Just once, and they will cross that line again and again, until at last, there is no turning back...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: I think Vasiliy... is beyond that line now, wandering in a darkness where he cannot even see his own hand before him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Open up! We... Uh, we have important news for the Little Sire.

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov Warden
dialogues.text: Hey! What's the password?

response.speaker: Izmaylov Warden
response.text: What? What is that?

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: No, uh, what he means is, he hasn't eaten anything since this morning and really wants some Sweet Madame... He's not talking about a password...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: The password is "Edib!"

response.speaker: Izmaylov Warden
response.text: Strange. The password checks out, but we didn't receive any prior notice...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon said it's urgent!

response.speaker: Izmaylov Warden
response.text: All right, all right. Just a moment, I'll open the gate...

response.speaker: Izmaylov Warden
response.text: Wait... You...

response.speaker: Izmaylov Warden
response.text: You are... You are the Luchkin!

response.speaker: Izmaylov Warden
response.text: Enemy attack! We're under attack!

response.speaker: Izmaylov Warden
response.text: Ah, I really haven't had that in ages... But that's not the password!

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: No, uh, what he means is, he wants to treat everyone on duty to some Fire-Water. He wasn't talking about the password... really...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: The password is "Edib!"

response.speaker: Izmaylov Warden
response.text: Hmm... No peoblem there.

talks.objective: Head into the depths of the Train Boneyard

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Keep going! We're almost there.

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: ...Just as I thought.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Those devices... They're activation devices! With this concentration of Shadow Realm Energy... there's only one final step...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then we're still in time.

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Heh, still in time. The old man loved saying things like that. But how many things in this world can truly be reached in time?

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: So you came after all, my dear little brother and sister...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Are you...!?

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: Vasha... the Little Sire, Vasily Edipovich Izmaylov.

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Oh? You even brought outsiders with you. Where did you find these hired thugs? How disgraceful. Now that the old man is gone, you need outsiders to help you make a stand?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: ...Stop this obsession of yours! Opening the Shadow Realm will bring no good. It will only cause more casualties! If this reaches the Druzhna... the entire High Table will be finished!

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Stop it, Brother. Before this gets any worse...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: It's not too late.

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Shut up! Zmei, what do you know... That old bastard wanted to leave his seat at the High Table to you. You think I didn't know that?

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: He would have made you the Speaker of the High Table simply because you want nothing, and because you would change nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Hah. For all this time, we fae gangs have always been looked down on...

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: All the odd jobs the Druzhna and Energy Commission don't want to do get dumped on the Izmaylov. Oh, snow's piled up on the train tracks? Then send Remusov!

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Those poor beggars, shivering in the cold with no money and no roof over their heads? Fine, have them report to Luchkin!

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: We're nothing but dogs to those lords! Dogs they can summon and dismiss at will!

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: You have no idea how many innocent people I've beaten for those lords above while collecting their debts... how much dirty work I've done for them.

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: But now, all of that is about to change... Our poor dear father cared so much about his Energy Commission, didn't he?

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Now, whatever the Energy Commision can do, I, Izmaylov, can do as well. And what the Energy Commission can't do, I, Izmaylo, can still do all the same!

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: The High Table? You can go play at that make-believe council yourselves! The Law? It's nothing but a leash the old man left around our necks!

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: Vasiliy!

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Sorry, I almost forgot there really is a dog here!

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: The old man spent his whole life as someone's dog, too. Hmph. He was a dog back at the Alpium, and even after he became president of the Energy Commission and Speaker of the High Table...

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: How impressive. But he was still someone else's dog. That night... I begged him again to let me take over his work...

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: But he said, "The mission is complete. I have already found what I sought in the Shadow Realm. From now on, even the Energy Commission will no longer involve itself too deeply in matters concerning the Shadow Realm...”

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: What a joke! To possess power like that and do nothing with it... Then what about us? What do we get for all that dirty work we did?

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: By the time... by the time I came back to my senses... the old man had already... Heh... Hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: ...So it really was you.

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Yeah, it was me. And now, the old man is gone. There is no one left to stand in my way!

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: I will have a seat in the real council! As long as I'm there, there will always be a place for Izmaylovs at Snezhnaya's table.

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: I will make those lords understand. I, Vasiliy Izmaylov, am no "Nikolayevich"! Nor am I the "Little Sire"!

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Come, my foolish little brother and sister! You won't be able to witness alongside me the future in which the name Izmaylov shines!

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Izmaylovs, prove your worth to me! Your sacrifice will be remembered!

talks.objective: Defeat opponents in the Shadow Realm

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: Stop this madness, Vasha! At this rate, the entire mine will collapse, and everyone nearby will die!

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Madness? This is a plan I've spent years putting together!

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: I will make people like us take a step forward... None of you can do it. Only I can. Only me!

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: ...Little Sire

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Don't you dare call me that! I will accomplish the great work the old man never could, and have people call me "Lord Vasiliy"...

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: In years to come, when people speak of the old man, of Nikolay Parhan Izmaylov, they will call him the father of Lord Vasiliy!

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: I will... surpass him. I will...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: But the Shadow Realm is too dangerous... You shouldn't get your hands on it. If the Shadow Realm gets out of control, you'll get yourself killed too!

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Do you have any other way? This is the right choice, for you, for me, and for the whole family. It will benefit us all!

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: There has to be another way...

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: What, with that bullshit Law that only lets us lie to ourselves? With the old man's way of doing things?

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: He spent his whole life building everything so carefully, and in the end, he's just a dead man.

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: He died by my hand... just as everyone does in the end... walking toward a death that cannot be undone.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Vasha...

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: That stubborn old man... I will prove to him that my path is the right path.

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Why... Why am I always... just one step short of what I want?

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: I can't see... I can't see anything... It's so... so dark.

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Ah... I remember now. When we were little... One time I hid so deep inside that I couldn't find the way out...

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: I was so scared back then... I thought I'd never get out again... In the end, some one... who was it...? Who was it...?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: It was Irina and me, Vasha. We called your name and found you.

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Yeah...

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Zmei... Are you there...?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: I'm here... Irina and I, we're both here...

dialogues.speaker: Vasiliy
dialogues.text: Take me away... I can't see anything here... Zmei, please take me away...

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: The device has shut down!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, that was close... That scared Paimon a little bit... I thought...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, what's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: The Shadow Realm may have affected the physical structure here. This tunnel collapsed like this before!

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Vasha... Vasha...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hurry, it's time to go!

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: Let's go, Zmei.

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: This way! We can get out!

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: We've recovered what we needed... Let's go!

talks.objective: Leave the area by mine cart

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: The tremors have stopped... and the Shadow Realm's influence seems to be fading, too...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Then, I suppose that's the end of the "Izmaylov" incident... If Vasha had figured out how to open the Shadow Realm, he could've taken the entire High Table down with him.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: On behalf of the Fae Gang Federation's High Table, the Luchkins, and everyone affected by Vasha's actions, thank you again...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, we couldn't have made it through all this so smoothly without your help.

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: Iryna thanks you both.

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Yes... Sofya of the Luchkin thanks you too. And Gureva as well — I'll thank you on her behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... It was nothing, really...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But if the Young Sire is... what's going to happen to the rest of the Izmaylovs?

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: The High Table will decide what to do next. You've already done more than enough for us, so we won't trouble you with the smaller affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: It may take some time to settle everything... If you can, please come by Zolnyy. And don't forget that we still have a small token of thanks for you both...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good idea!

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Come visit anytime, if you'd like. I... I'll even let you pet my tail!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why are you always like this when tails are involved?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahem! Anyway, we'll definitely come visit!

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: You're always welcome anytime, friends of the Luchkins.

choices.text: I'd still visit even without the tail...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: So my tail isn't that appealing after all...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't think you really understand...

dialogues.speaker: Ordinary Izmaylov Guard
dialogues.text: The last people to see the Old Sire before his passing were the Butcher and the Young Sire...

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov Guard Captain
dialogues.text: ...Do you have a death wish, talking about that here!? I'll pretend I didn't hear anything. Please, for both our sakes, don't bring it up again...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...What is that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A matryoshka doll? Who put it here— gah, and why's it so damn noisy?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Layers and layers of— Seriously, who places stuff like this here? Inconsiderate piece of...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Alright. Time to make a break for it, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Gureva
dialogues.text: Hurry, he’s almost here. We need to hide before he arrives.
